source: beginner short story written in spoken Israeli Hebrew by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: We're sitting in a small restaurant.
The waiter gives us a menu.

sentences.ar: אני מזמין דג ואשתי מזמינה סלט.
sentences.en: I order fish and my wife orders salad.
The food is tasty and the place is quiet.
In the end we pay and go.
